sources.title: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio: qwen3.8-max
sources.evidence: Updated October 11, 2026. Describes the current Max endpoint as a 2.4-trillion-parameter MoE. The dedicated 0902 snapshot section names its long-date alias, lists text/image/video inputs and text output, function calling, thinking, and a 1,000,000-token context.

sources.title: [Model Studio] Update Notice for Qwen3.8-Max Models
sources.evidence: September 2 notice explicitly identifies the September 2 snapshot and permits direct testing before September 5. It announces that the qwen3.8-max endpoint will transition to qwen3.8-max-0902 on September 5.

sources.title: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Release tables explicitly date qwen3.8-max-0902 to September 2, 2026, including Singapore, Beijing and global scopes. This is release evidence independent of the model-name suffix.

sources.title: Alibaba Unveils Qwen3.8-Max: Its Largest and Most Capable Flagship Model to Date
sources.evidence: The August 3 launch release attributes Qwen3.8-Max to Alibaba and reports a nominal total of 2.4T, 95B activated, sparse MoE and hybrid attention. This predates the 0902 revision; its active count is not a direct disclosure for that revision.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B model card
sources.evidence: The open checkpoint is text-only and requires thinking. Its language-model section reports 2.4T total and 95B active. The card distinguishes hosted Qwen3.8-Max, which adds vision, optional thinking and tools. It does not identify its weights as the 0902 snapshot.

sources.title: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio: PDF understanding
sources.evidence: Updated October 23. Explicitly lists qwen3.8-max-0902 among models accepting PDFs by URL or Base64 in Beijing and Singapore. PDF input is unsupported through the Responses API.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Max-0902 - QwenCloud
sources.evidence: Exact snapshot page confirms its ID and long-date alias, thinking mode, function calling and 1M context. Alibaba describes improvements to coding, agent coordination and visual document analysis; those are vendor performance claims.

sources.title: Qwen Context Cache feature
sources.evidence: Classifies qwen3.8-max-0902 under Qwen Max and separately identifies qwen3.8-2.4t-a95b and qwen3.8-27b as Qwen Open-source models.

sources.title: Models.dev Qwen3.8 Max 0902 record
sources.evidence: Original catalog lead was inspected. It points to Alibaba and QwenCloud documentation and asserts the baseline date, modalities and capabilities; these were checked against developer sources.

developer.note: Alibaba announces the Max model and its hosted snapshot update.

family.note: Part of Alibaba's Qwen Max family.

release_date.note: Explicit primary release-table date, corroborated by same-day availability notice. September 5 is the moving-alias transition, not initial snapshot availability. Some provider directories show September 1; primary evidence supports September 2.

open_weights.note: The exact hosted variant is documented, but no exact released weights or explicit primary closed-weight classification was verified. A separate checkpoint or an unsuccessful repository search does not prove this variant is closed.

license.note: No exact weight artifact and corresponding license were verified for this hosted variant. API terms and other checkpoint or companion-software licenses do not establish a weight license here.

parameters_b.note: Nominal hosted-model disclosure: current Max documentation states 2.4T and the explicit endpoint mapping identifies 0902. The launch source calls 2.4T a total. This is not a tensor-derived count or an extrapolation from open checkpoint weights.

active_parameters_b.note: 95B is disclosed for August Max and the separate open language model. The reviewed current hosted documentation does not repeat an active count for 0902; exact snapshot coverage remains unresolved.

architecture.note: Current Max documentation states MoE; the explicit alias transition links it to 0902. No layer or expert counts are inferred from the separate checkpoint.

context_window.note: Exact snapshot context limit is 1,000,000 tokens. Its 991,808-token maximum input is a separate limit.

modalities.note: Snapshot capability table confirms text/image/video to text; dedicated PDF documentation explicitly includes 0902, subject to region and API restrictions.

reasoning.note: Exact snapshot supports thinking mode, with an enable_thinking API example.

tool_call.note: Function calling is explicitly supported for this snapshot.

description.value: September 2026 snapshot of Qwen3.8 Max with a one-million-token context, thinking mode, tool calling, and text, image, video and PDF input.
description.note: Describes the dated endpoint and documented capabilities without vendor performance claims.

patch.description: September 2026 snapshot of Qwen3.8 Max with a one-million-token context, thinking mode, tool calling, and text, image, video and PDF input.

sources.label: Alibaba Max model and snapshot specifications

patch.notes: 2.4T is Alibaba's nominal hosted Max total, linked to 0902 through its documented endpoint mapping; it is not a complete tensor census. An exact 0902 active count remains unverified: 95B was disclosed for the August Max launch and separate text-only open checkpoint. The latter is not the hosted multimodal snapshot. PDF input is supported in Beijing/Singapore through Chat Completions, not Responses. Exact weight-release status and a corresponding weight license remain unverified.

summary: Adds a nominal 2400B hosted-model count and MoE architecture using current primary specifications plus an explicit alias mapping, without deriving a full hosted count from the open text checkpoint. Confirms September 2 public release and all baseline capabilities, including exact-snapshot PDF support. Attributes performance improvements to Alibaba. Exact 0902 active parameters remain unresolved. Parent review leaves exact weight availability and license unverified rather than inferring closed weights from hosting or absent search results.
